faqs.q: How long does it take to build a mobile app?
faqs.a: A simple app usually takes 6 to 10 weeks. Apps with payments, real-time tracking or complex admin panels take longer. We give you a timeline after scoping.

faqs.q: Should I build a native app or a cross-platform app?
faqs.a: For most businesses, a cross-platform app in Flutter or React Native is the better value: one codebase covers both iPhone and Android. Fully native apps make sense for very graphics-heavy or hardware-specific features.

faqs.q: Do you publish the app to the App Store and Play Store?
faqs.a: Yes. We prepare the listings and handle the submission. The developer accounts are created in your business name so you own the apps.
